t: A beginner text programming language based on BASIC with a few keywords.
steps: Download SmallBasic.msi on a Windows computer, or install from the Microsoft Store.
Ask IT for approval to install on school machines.
Open the editor and run a short program.
Find the Small Basic Teaching Curriculum on the Microsoft blog.
Check the status of Small Basic Online before relying on it.
Plan for the older release. It has not changed since 2015.
